entries.title: Psalms 9:1
segments: To the Chief Musician. To die for the Son. A Psalm of David. I will praise [You], O LORD, with my whole heart; I will tell of all Your marvelous works.

entries.title: Psalms 9:2
segments: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.

entries.title: Psalms 9:3
segments: When my enemies have turned back, they shall fall and perish before You.

entries.title: Psalms 9:4
segments: For You have maintained my right and my cause; You sat in the throne judging right.

entries.title: Psalms 9:5
segments: You have rebuked the heathen, You have destroyed the wicked, You have put out their name forever and ever.

entries.title: Psalms 9:6
segments: The desolations of the enemy have come to an end forever, and You have destroyed the cities; their memorial has perished with them.

entries.title: Psalms 9:7
segments: But the LORD shall endure forever; He has prepared His throne for judgment.

entries.title: Psalms 9:8
segments: And He shall judge the world in righteousness; He shall judge the peoples in uprightness.

entries.title: Psalms 9:9
segments: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

entries.title: Psalms 9:10
segments: And those who know Your name will put their trust in You; for You, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.

entries.title: Psalms 9:11
segments: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion; declare among the nations His deeds.

entries.title: Psalms 9:12
segments: For He remembers them, the seekers of bloodshed; He forgets not the cry of the humble.

entries.title: Psalms 9:13
segments: Have mercy on me, O LORD; see my trouble from those who hate me, You who lift me up from the gates of death,

entries.title: Psalms 9:14
segments: so that I may declare all Your praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion; I will rejoice in Your salvation.

entries.title: Psalms 9:15
segments: The nations have sunk down in the pit [that] they made; their foot is caught in the net which they hid.

entries.title: Psalms 9:16
segments: The LORD is known. He has executed judgment; the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. A meditation. Selah.

entries.title: Psalms 9:17
segments: The wicked shall be turned into hell, all the nations that forget God.

entries.title: Psalms 9:18
segments: For the needy shall not always be forgotten; the hope of the poor shall [not] perish forever.

entries.title: Psalms 9:19
segments: Arise, O LORD; let not man be strong. Let the nations be judged in Your sight.

entries.title: Psalms 9:20
segments: Put them in fear, O LORD, let the nations know they [are] but men. Selah.
